most_important_questions: Rank 1: Define electric dipole and give formula for dipole moment. Find expression for torque acting on electric dipole in uniform electric field. - Electric Charge, Electric Field and Electric Dipole (3 marks, Section D, 2025)

Rank 2: Write Gauss's law. Derive formula for electric field due to a linear charge distribution (E = lambda / 2*pi*epsilon_0*r). - Electric Flux and Gauss Theorem (3 marks, Section D, 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022)

Rank 3: State Gauss's law in electrostatics. Using it find electric field due to uniformly charged thin spherical shell — at external, internal and surface points. - Electric Flux and Gauss Theorem (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022 — Every Year)
Rank 4: Establish relation between drift velocity and electric current: I = nAev_d. - Electric Conduction and Ohms Law (3 or 5 marks, Section D or E, 2022, 2024, 2025)
Rank 5: State Biot-Savart's law. With help of this law determine magnetic field at centre of circular current carrying coil. - Moving Charges and Magnetism (5 marks, Section E, 2024, 2022, 2025)
Rank 6: What is solenoid? Obtain expression for magnetic field inside long current-carrying solenoid using Ampere's law: B = mu_0*n*I. - Moving Charges and Magnetism (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024)

Rank 7: Draw series resonance circuit for LCR. Derive formula for resonant frequency f_0 = 1/2pi*sqrt(LC). How does resonant frequency depend on resistance? - Alternating Current (3 marks, Section D, 2025, 2024, 2023)

Rank 8: What is principle of transformer? Explain step-up transformer by drawing circuit diagram. Numerical on turns ratio and power. - Alternating Current (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022 — Every Year)

Rank 9: If medium on both sides of lens is same, derive formula for focal length of thin lens in terms of refractive index and radius of curvature (Lens Maker's formula). - Refraction of Light on Spherical Surfaces and Lenses (3 or 5 marks, Section D or E, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 — Every Year)
Rank 10: State Huygens' principle of secondary wavelets and explain laws of refraction of light on its basis. - Nature of Light and Interference (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024, 2023)

Rank 11: What is interference of light? Deduce expression for fringe width (beta = lambda*D/d) in Young's double slit experiment. - Nature of Light and Interference (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022 — Every Year)

Rank 12: Explain the diffraction of monochromatic light at a single slit. Find expression for angular width of central maxima (= 2*lambda/a). - Diffraction and Polarisation of Light (5 marks, Section E, 2025, Model Paper)

Rank 13: What is photoelectric effect? Write its laws. Establish Einstein's photoelectric equation: (1/2)mv^2 = h(v - v_0). - Photoelectric Effect and Matter Waves (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024, 2023 — Every Year)

Rank 14: What is concept of matter-wave of de-Broglie? Establish relation for de-Broglie wavelength in terms of kinetic energy: lambda = h/sqrt(2mE). - Photoelectric Effect and Matter Waves (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024)

Rank 15: Write Bohr's postulates for hydrogen atom. Prove that orbital radius r is directly proportional to square of principal quantum number n (r proportional to n^2). - Atomic Structure and Hydrogen Spectrum (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024)

Rank 16: Explain image formation in reflecting telescope with ray diagram. Compare its qualities with refracting telescope. - Refraction and Dispersion of Light by Prism and Optical Instruments (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024, 2023)
Rank 17: Represent graphically binding energy per nucleon against mass number. Explain why lighter nuclei are usually suitable for nuclear fusion. - Nuclei (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024, 2023)

Rank 18: How is p-n junction diode used as full wave rectifier? Explain working by drawing simple circuit diagram. Draw input/output voltage waveforms. - Semiconductor and Junction Diode (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022 — Every Year)

Rank 19: What are energy bands in solids? Differentiate between conductors, insulators and semiconductors on basis of energy bands. Explain effects of temperature. - Semiconductor and Junction Diode (5 marks, Section E, 2025, 2024)

Rank 20: By drawing ray diagram explain image formation in compound microscope. Establish formula for magnifying power. - Refraction and Dispersion of Light by Prism and Optical Instruments (5 marks, Section E, 2024, 2025)

tips: Section D carries 30 marks — this is the highest-scoring section. Prepare EVERY standard 3-mark derivation.
Section E: 4 OR choices given — read all 8 options during reading time, choose wisely.

For proofs: always start by writing the law or theorem statement. Then numbered derivation steps.

answer_sheet_rules: question_number_note: Haan — har answer ke upar question number likhna zaroori hai. Examiner dhundhta hai. Nahi likha toh marks confusion ho sakta hai.
set_number_note: Haan — apna set number (JS/JT/JU/JV/JW etc.) answer sheet ke cover page par compulsory likhna hota hai.
question_copy_note: Answer sheet mein poora question likhna zaroori nahi. Sirf question number likho aur answer shuru karo.
rough_work: Answer sheet ka last page rough work ke liye. Clearly ROUGH WORK likho. Rough work pe marks nahi milte lekin kaam aata hai.
supplementary_sheet: Supplementary sheet lene se marks nahi katenge. Zaroorat ho toh lo. Lekin unnecessary blank pages waste mat karo.
sequence_note: Questions ka sequence follow karna zaroori nahi. Jo aata ho pehle karo. Lekin question number clearly likho.
last_to_first: Haan — paper last se bhi start kar sakte ho. Koi rule nahi ki sequence follow karo.
long_answer_position: Long answers (Section D aur E) hamesha paper ke last mein nahi hote. Jo bhi section easy lage pehle karo.
section_name_before_section: Section ka naam likhna compulsory nahi lekin recommended hai. Examiner ko navigate karna easy hota hai.
line_after_each_question: Zaroori nahi. Lekin do lines draw karne se answer clearly separate dikhta hai — good practice.
cutting_overwriting: Cuts se marks directly nahi katenge. Ek clean line se kato. Clean cutting acceptable hai.
short_before_long: Pehle short answers attempt karo phir long — marks nahi katenge. Jo bhi order suit kare.
sub_questions: Sub questions matlab ek question ke andar (a), (b), (c), (d) parts hote hain. Har part ke marks alag alag hote hain.

pen_rules.note: Blue pen se main answer, black se headings/underline. Ya sirf ek color bhi chalega.
